titleEn: Count the Number of Powerful Integers
title: 统计强大整数的数目
summary: 统计闭区间 [start,finish] 中以给定字符串 s 结尾、且每一位数字都不超过 limit 的正整数数量。
insight: 用 count(bound) 统计不超过 bound 的合法数，再作前缀差。按总位数枚举，末尾位置强制填写 s，其余位置枚举不超过 limit 的数字；对与 bound 等长的情况用 tight 状态保证不越界。
pitfalls: 答案和边界需要 64 位
后缀位置必须逐位固定
s 可能与 bound 等长

solutions.title: 固定后缀的数位 DP
solutions.idea: 按位数和紧致状态统计所有合法十进制表示。
steps: 枚举 length 从 s.length 到 bound 的位数
dp[tight] 表示已填前缀是否仍贴合 bound
普通位置枚举首位一到 limit、其余零到 limit
末尾 s.length 个位置只允许对应后缀数字
累加每种长度的两种 tight 状态

code.java: class Solution { private long count(long bound,int limit,String suffix){if(bound<=0)return 0;String cap=Long.toString(bound);int totalLength=cap.length(),suffixLength=suffix.length();long answer=0;for(int length=suffixLength;length<=totalLength;length++){boolean fullLength=length==totalLength;long[] dp={0,1};for(int position=0;position<length;position++){long[] next=new long[2];int forced=position>=length-suffixLength?suffix.charAt(position-(length-suffixLength))-'0':-1;for(int tight=0;tight<=1;tight++)if(dp[tight]>0){int upper=tight==1&&fullLength?cap.charAt(position)-'0':9;int lower=position==0?1:0;if(forced>=0){if(forced>=lower&&forced<=limit&&forced<=upper)next[tight==1&&fullLength&&forced==upper?1:0]+=dp[tight];}else for(int digit=lower;digit<=Math.min(limit,upper);digit++)next[tight==1&&fullLength&&digit==upper?1:0]+=dp[tight];}dp=next;}answer+=dp[0]+dp[1];}return answer;}public long numberOfPowerfulInt(long start,long finish,int limit,String s){return count(finish,limit,s)-count(start-1,limit,s);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun count(bound:Long,limit:Int,suffix:String):Long{if(bound<=0)return 0;val cap=bound.toString();val totalLength=cap.length;val suffixLength=suffix.length;var answer=0L;for(length in suffixLength..totalLength){val fullLength=length==totalLength;var dp=longArrayOf(0,1);for(position in 0 until length){val next=LongArray(2);val forced=if(position>=length-suffixLength)suffix[position-(length-suffixLength)]-'0' else -1;for(tight in 0..1)if(dp[tight]>0){val upper=if(tight==1&&fullLength)cap[position]-'0' else 9;val lower=if(position==0)1 else 0;if(forced>=0){if(forced>=lower&&forced<=limit&&forced<=upper)next[if(tight==1&&fullLength&&forced==upper)1 else 0]+=dp[tight]}else for(digit in lower..minOf(limit,upper))next[if(tight==1&&fullLength&&digit==upper)1 else 0]+=dp[tight]};dp=next};answer+=dp[0]+dp[1]};return answer};fun numberOfPowerfulInt(start:Long,finish:Long,limit:Int,s:String):Long=count(finish,limit,s)-count(start-1,limit,s) }
code.cpp: class Solution { long long count(long long bound,int limit,const string& suffix){if(bound<=0)return 0;string cap=to_string(bound);int totalLength=cap.size(),suffixLength=suffix.size();long long answer=0;for(int length=suffixLength;length<=totalLength;++length){bool fullLength=length==totalLength;array<long long,2> dp={0,1};for(int position=0;position<length;++position){array<long long,2> next={0,0};int forced=position>=length-suffixLength?suffix[position-(length-suffixLength)]-'0':-1;for(int tight=0;tight<=1;++tight)if(dp[tight]){int upper=tight&&fullLength?cap[position]-'0':9,lower=position==0?1:0;if(forced>=0){if(forced>=lower&&forced<=limit&&forced<=upper)next[tight&&fullLength&&forced==upper]+=dp[tight];}else for(int digit=lower;digit<=min(limit,upper);++digit)next[tight&&fullLength&&digit==upper]+=dp[tight];}dp=next;}answer+=dp[0]+dp[1];}return answer;}public:long long numberOfPowerfulInt(long long start,long long finish,int limit,string s){return count(finish,limit,s)-count(start-1,limit,s);} };
